title: Rene's high endings and his records
summary: Miller says Rene's endings went an octave higher and that his records were disappointing; they discuss musicians who hold back their best material.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: You can't give us an imitation of Rene, huh?
Nothing but his endings. I used to make some bad endings.
Yeah, okay. Let's hear some of his endings. You can finish.
I wasn't in the right key though, but he used to make them.
I was like, oh, I'm going to run easy.
But he played so high that you can't imitate him. I can't imitate him.
He'd make F, A, C sharp, just like a smile. Well, I have done it. I used to do it, but I can't do it now. He don't give him a miss, no.
Well, how many notes would he play when he was up there? Would he just hit one, or would he play a lot of fingering up there?
Yeah, man. I'm telling you, he played up there. I can play a... What did I say? I can play a... I don't know if it was any of them. I mean, any of them...
Could you transpose it down to a lower key or something?
He played in the original, you know, key. Then he octave plays.
Yeah. Well, can you play something an octave lower? Me? Yeah. In his style, you know, but an octave lower.
I'm trying to figure what pieces he used to play. Oh, yeah.
Oh, that's one of his famous pieces.
He'd make all that an octave higher. Yeah, he did.
Not that it's beautiful, but he'd do this octave higher.
That's funny. When he made the record, you know, he didn't do any of his stuff.
Well, I tell you, I believe when he made them records, he had kind of lose his lip a little.
No, he told his brother that he wasn't going to give him any of his stuff, you know. Oh, well, he was silly. He was playing straight melodies. Well, he was just silly to that.
Well, a lot of guys... Yeah, he wasn't doing nobody no good but himself.
Yeah. A lot of guys are like that, you know.
But, I mean, I don't see why they would do that when they're helping their own self, man.
Yeah, I know, but they think they're helping the other guy.
Oh, see. Anything I know, the other guy can go ahead and love it. If you want, I'm going to do it for myself. Yeah.
Yeah, well, they think somebody else is going to learn it and all that. They think all that stuff.
